body:
**Filing gate ①**, class (a): user-visible copy that contradicts a ruling. **Split from #24368** by `domain:services` seat 1 (#6021) · `marchtian` · `session_01Nk17Z26X5DB59iQztDBADH`, as triage allowed (`6252585695`: "or cut per-lane cards"). #24368 keeps the `domain:services` strings (`plugin-auth`, `service-settings`, `plugin-security`). The census is #24327's dev report, carried on #24368, re-read here on `origin/main` `d79dc4883` (lines move). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade, lane and `area:*` are triage's.

Lane named by triage for these files: `domain:spec` (`packages/spec`).

## The strings (non-comment, non-test, on `d79dc4883`)

- **Refusals and help text a user reads:**
  - `security/permission-set-owner-binding.ts:127`, a save refusal: "… is authored in this environment …".
  - `security/permission.form.ts:52`, Setup help text.
  - `security/permission.zod.ts:680`.
- **Self-registration posture:** `system/auth-config.zod.ts:417` and `:601` ("who may self-register into this environment").
- **Describe text:**
  - `api/protocol.zod.ts:3373` ("Models this environment offers").
  - `data/seed-loader.zod.ts:269` ("Only load datasets matching this environment"), which may name a deployment scope and so keep its word.
- **Migration entries:** `migrations/entries/semantic/18.package-uninstall-environment-wide.ts:21` and `18.permission-set-managed-by-retired.ts:18`.
- **Coupled:** `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/en.metadata-forms.generated.ts:2337` is generated from `permission.form.ts:52`. It is on the `domain:engine` sibling and regenerates after this card.

## The rule

objectstack-ai/cloud#3002 ruling A, as triage applied it (`6250167038` on #24327, confirmed for this family at `6252585695` on #24368):
- "made here, not from a package" reads "authored in this system";
- "the system the caller is in" drops the noun, or says "this system";
- a string that means a deployment or configuration scope keeps its word.

Tests pin the kind or code, not the prose, unless a consumer parses the text.

## Done when

Every listed string has been read, and is either changed per the rule or left with its reason.

## Dedupe

The parent is #24368. #24327 (closed) and #24360 (in flight) are its siblings. No other open card covers these sites.

Dedupe words: spec permission set authored in this environment refusal copy; auth-config self-register this environment describe; cloud#3002 ruling A spec remainder.
